Hi Samir — great conversation earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on success criteria and who owns what for the trial.

Summary from call:
- Primary goal: validate streaming clinical-note augmentation for triage workflows (latency < 250ms p95, F1 > 0.88 on a held-out validation set).
- Scope: 2 endpoints (realtime streaming suggestions + batch re-ranking), sample size ~5k clinical notes over a 2-week run.
- Data handling: ClearPath will provide de-identified sample set; Redwood will run inference in our hosted tenancy (can move to Dedicated if needed).

Proposed success criteria (we discussed):
1) Latency: end-to-end p95 < 250ms for 512-token baseline.
2) Quality: suggestion F1 >= 0.88 vs ClearPath labeling.
3) Stability: >= 99.5% availability during peak window.
4) SDK integration: streaming client can reconnect/resume and preserve KV cache across transient failures.

Immediate next steps (owners):
- ClearPath: share de-identified dataset + schema (LYDIA) — target 2026-08-24.
- Redwood (Marissa): provide SDK stub and sample route names + streaming examples — target 2026-08-22.
- Redwood (Ben): architecture diagram + suggested throughput targets and batching configs — target 2026-08-23.
- Procurement: Samir to share PO timing and any special contract clauses — target 2026-08-25.

Attachments I've uploaded to the shared Drive: redwood-poc-matrix.xlsx (acceptance matrix), streaming-router-diagram.png (suggested routing/backup fallbacks), redwood-trial-sla-draft.pdf. I put links in the HubSpot deal.

Adding the operational checklist and a pragmatic runbook for the two-week trial:
- Pre-run (Day -3 to 0): deploy SDK stub to staging, validate streaming handshake, verify encryption config, run a 200-note smoke test. Owner: ClearPath (Lydia) + Redwood (Marissa).
- Run day 1: ramp to 50% throughput for 4h, collect latency traces and token counts. Redwood will enable prefix caching for repeated patient templates.
- Mid-run (Day 7): run quality evaluation against labeled subset, do a 1-hr incident simulation (simulate reconnects).
- Final acceptance (Day 14): run full-sample evaluation, sign acceptance if all gates pass; fallback plan: if F1 below target, enable tuned quantization profile and run additional 3-day probe.

Operational notes:
- Route naming and example curl (minimal harness):
  curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams/annotate -d '{"patient_id":"p123","text":"<clinical note>"}'

- Logging/observability: we'll provide a temporary tracing token so ClearPath can stream traces to their observability stack (link in Drive).

I'll push the router diagram and a filled acceptance matrix to the Drive folder now. Let me know if you want a short live runbook walkthrough; otherwise we can do a 30-min engineering sync Tuesday 10am PT.
